desc: Prove and document that f(L,R) is the number of connected components of the distinct value set in A[L..R], and derive the identity f(L,R) = distinct_count(L,R) - adjacent_pair_count(L,R).
Implement the occurrence-list gap arithmetic solution in Python, including efficient input/output and 64-bit integer handling.
Verify the implementation on the provided samples and edge cases: N=1, all values equal, all values distinct, long consecutive value blocks, and sparse values.
